about: Section 6. hash = SHA-256(lp("lucid-console-audit-v1", prev as 32 raw bytes, canonical_json(entry without hash))); the first entry ever has a prev of 64 zeros. canonical_json is CE-1 canonical JSON with null written as null. Lines here are the canonical JSON of each entry with its hash; a verifier re-encodes, so any JSON layout of the same values verifies. 'expect' is what tools/verify_console_audit.py answers: through is the last seq that verifies, broken_at the seq expected at the first line that does not, line that line (1-based), why one of parse, keys, form, seq, prev, anchor, hash.
